freshness_method: Guarded promotion must check exact target IDs against all canonical Urdu A1-B1 and live B2 sequences 1-18 immediately before append.

targets.intended_sense: literal threshold or entrance edge whose height and form affect access
divided into separate parts or groups
tunnel carrying movement below or through an obstacle
disruption or interruption in normal movement or service
ambulance or emergency medical transport vehicle
reserved or set aside for a specified use
sound or voice as part of the experienced acoustic environment
visible horizon or distant visual line used when discussing views and skyline
recorded video footage used as observational evidence
register or structured written log of observations or entries

generation_guardrails: B2 passage text remains in the 350-550 whitespace-token production band.
P1-P5 introduce exactly two new lexical targets each; P6 introduces none and visibly recycles all ten.
Difficulty comes from design tradeoffs, distributional effects, implementation constraints, evidence quality, and user perspectives rather than vocabulary density.
Urban cases are fictional and avoid implying that one design solution fits every city or population.
Accessibility, emergency access, surveillance, and public-space discussion remain general and non-individualized.
Generation/integrity state remains separate from educator/publication release approval.
